en:
The BMW Connected Drive integration has been removed from Home Assistant.

In September 2025, BMW blocked third-party access to their servers by adding additional security measures. For EU-registered cars, a community-developed [custom component]({custom_component_url}) using BMW's CarData API is available as an alternative.

To resolve this issue, please remove the (now defunct) integration entries from your Home Assistant setup. [View your existing BMW Connected Drive integration entries]({entries}).
sv:
Integrationen BMW Connected Drive har tagits bort från Home Assistant.

I september 2025 blockerade BMW tredjepartsåtkomst till sina servrar genom ytterligare säkerhetsåtgärder. För EU-registrerade bilar finns en [anpassad komponent] utvecklad av communityn({custom_component_url}) som använder BMW:s CarData API som alternativ.

För att lösa problemet tar du bort de numera obrukbara integrationsposterna från din Home Assistant-konfiguration. [Visa dina befintliga BMW Connected Drive-integrationsposter]({entries}).
